why.implementer: Eight ordered steps, each building on the one before (shared Review, line marks, case rules, change reading, stage frames, freeze overlay, wiring, tests).
why.test-author: New behaviour a test can pin: the status writes and their guards, three planning requests, the hand-off, the change since the base and seven acceptance scenarios.
why.backend-security-reviewer: Spawns git with arguments from a case file a session wrote, fetches from origin into the user's repository, and types requests into a running session.
